ST-D1-011.composed_text: the participant stated that a specific issue existed and identified what it was

ST-D2-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant named the step that had not been completed and identified who was assigned to it

ST-D3-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant restated the agreed sequence before beginning the task

ST-D4-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant restated the question that had been asked before answering it

ST-D5-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant set out the point of disagreement and the point of agreement separately

ST-D8-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant returned to the task after the interruption and stated what had already been completed

ST-D9-TEST-001.composed_text: the participant repeated the revised instruction back and asked which part to do differently

controlled_texts.T-PURPOSE-001: A record documenting selected conduct observed in defined workplace situations. The participant controls whether this report is available to approved employers through The 3rd Academy and may withdraw future availability at any time.
controlled_texts.T-VERIFCAP-001: Verify the authoritative status before relying on this copy.
T-SCOPE-001: This report contains recorded conduct for represented dimensions only. It is not a complete account of the participant's workplace conduct. Dimensions not represented are listed below; their absence is not a conclusion about the participant. This report records selected conduct in defined situations and does not state whether a participant should be selected, placed, promoted, preferred, or otherwise chosen for an opportunity.
controlled_texts.T-FRAME-REC: Recorded in each of the {context_count} Stage contexts identified for this entry:
controlled_texts.T-LIMIT-001: This statement is limited to the recorded contexts. It is not a statement about character, general tendency, suitability, or future behavior.
controlled_texts.T-ILLUS-001: Illustrative only. An approved Recorded Conduct Entry renders here.
controlled_texts.T-DIFF-SEP: These observations remain separate. Neither is preferred, averaged, or used to broaden the recurrence statement.
T-DIFFSHOWN-001: The recurring clause stays in Observed conduct. The adjacent Differences across settings field preserves context specific variation. A difference does not erase recurrence of a separate clause, and recurrence does not erase the difference.
controlled_texts.T-AVAIL-001: Made available to approved employers through the participant controlled process. Evidence current until: {d}. Verification reference: {r}.
controlled_texts.T-STUB-001: No recorded conduct for these dimensions is carried here. Their absence is not a conclusion about the participant.
controlled_texts.T-EVNOTE-001: Stage 1 written situations are administered through an AI system. A Stage 1 observation enters the evidence record only after authorized human confirmation. Source linked statements remain subject to participant review, correction, amendment and evidence currency controls.
T-USE-001: This report provides supplementary behavioral evidence from defined workplace situations. It may be considered as one source of information in an employer's independent employment judgment. It does not recommend or determine an employment decision and must not be used as the sole basis for adverse employment action. It is not a prediction of job performance, retention or probation outcome.
T-DISC-001: This report was made available at the participant's discretion and covers only the evidence window stated above. Withdrawal ends availability for subsequent access through The 3rd Academy; it does not recall a copy already read. Earlier or later reports may exist; this page is not the complete observation history.
T-INTEG-001: Statements are source linked and subject to participant review, correction, amendment and evidence currency controls. Withdrawal is governed separately and applies to employer availability, not to the evidence record.
T-VERIF-001: A verification check confirms authenticity and current status; it does not disclose report content or participant identity.
controlled_texts.T-NOTREP-ALL: Every dimension in the catalogue is represented in this report.
controlled_texts.T-DEMO-001: This page is a layout specimen. It is not an issued report and records no conduct by any person.
controlled_texts.T-PILOT-MARK: PILOT OUTPUT — NOT AN ISSUED REPORT
controlled_texts.T-FRAME-ONE: In one situation, recorded in the Stage context identified for this entry:
controlled_texts.T-FRAME-MULTI: Recorded in {context_count} Stage contexts identified for this entry:
controlled_texts.T-FRAME-DIV: Recorded in {context_count} Stage contexts identified for this entry, with the differences shown alongside:
controlled_texts.T-COLOPHON-001: Issued under a published evidence standard. Version and governing rules at verify.the3rdacademy.com
controlled_texts.T-COVERAGE-001: Representation states that recorded conduct for a dimension is carried in this report. It is not a score, a rating, a ranking or an endorsement. The number of represented dimensions reflects what was observed and approved, not how the participant performed, and a report with few represented dimensions is not a weaker report.
controlled_texts.T-NODIFF-001: No difference across settings is recorded for this entry.
